name: Amplitude
summary: Product analytics: funnels, retention and behavioural cohorts, plus session replay and experimentation.
best_for: product teams who want everyone looking at the same behavioural data — the free 2 million events a month is a real working tier, not a demo
skip_if: you need page-and-session web analytics rather than product events, because that is a different tool and much cheaper; also skip it if your event volume is unpredictable and you cannot get a rate card
honest_knock: Unlimited seats is genuinely unusual and worth the credit — you are not taxed for letting the whole team look. The cost lands on events instead, and events are the thing you control least: an instrumentation change or a growth spurt moves your bill without anyone choosing to upgrade. What the plan cards do not print, the page's own bill estimator does, and we read the whole Plus ladder there on 17 September and again, unchanged, on 4 October 2026. What it shows is how little volume buys you: the marginal million events costs $94 a month at the bottom of the ladder and still $86.25 at the 70-million ceiling where Plus stops, and above that ceiling nothing is published. And 'expanded packages are priced as a percentage of your platform plan' means the add-ons scale with your bill rather than with your usage of them — the more events you send, the more the extras cost, whether or not you use them more. Get the per-event rate in writing before you instrument.

pricing.notes: (2026-09-17, re-read on their own pricing page and again on 2026-10-04, unchanged) Free $0 with 2 million events a month, permanently, no card required and no time limit. Plus starts at $0 with the first 2 million events free and scales up to 70 million events; a card is required and the card itself offers an estimator rather than a rate. Growth and Enterprise are quote-only, both described as event-based pricing. The page states every plan includes the full platform and unlimited seats, and that expanded packages are priced as a percentage of your platform plan. Startups with under $10 million in funding and fewer than 20 employees are offered one free year on Growth, applied for rather than self-served. The published caps that do differ by tier are session replays (10,000 a month on Free and Plus, 20,000 on Growth, 50,000 on Enterprise), active experiments (one on Free and Plus, two on Growth and Enterprise, more as an add-on) and agent sessions (5,000, 10,000 and 20,000). Plus can also be metered on monthly tracked users instead of events: the comparison table caps Plus at 700K MTU or 70M events, and the page's estimator prices that ladder from $52 a month for 1,000 MTU to $5,338 for 700,000 (read 4 October 2026).

open_questions.question: Can you publish a price, or a starting price, for the plans that are quote-only?
Can a customer cancel at any time, and what happens to an annual plan that is cancelled mid-term?
Which data can a customer export, in which formats, on which plans?
Where is customer data stored, and can a customer choose the region?
Is there a minimum number of seats or users on any plan?
